title: VSift transcript.get JSON Lines terminal data v1
description: The data member of the complete or partial terminal result that ends a transcript.get --events jsonl stream. It is the page of transcript-get-data.schema.json without its items: the page's segments were the preceding evidence events, in start order, and record_count says how many there were. transcript_coverage (0.2.1) is the page's own: the coverage of the whole requested range, and when part of it has no transcript the terminal result is partial with its envelope coverage listing those ranges, as for the page. Pass next_cursor back with the same session and range to stream the next page; null means the range is exhausted.

transcript_coverage.description: The coverage of the whole requested range, the same on every page of one request: always present since 0.2.1, but not listed in required, because answers of the published 0.1.0 (kept valid against this schema by the compatibility test) have none.
